sources.title: 從掃描到治療計畫：AI 如何協助彌補乳癌最致命的照護缺口 / From Scan to Treatment Plan, AI Helps Close Breast Cancer’s Deadliest Gaps
sources.title_zh: 從掃描到治療計畫：AI 如何協助彌補乳癌最致命的照護缺口
sources.title_en: From Scan to Treatment Plan, AI Helps Close Breast Cancer’s Deadliest Gaps
sources.title_original: From Scan to Treatment Plan, AI Helps Close Breast Cancer’s Deadliest Gaps
sources.summary: Breast cancer is the most commonly diagnosed cancer among American women — yet the gaps in care are wide. A majority of women over age 40 skip the recommended annual screening. Radiologists are reading more mammograms with fewer colleagues. And when a diagnosis arrives, the tests that inform treatment can take weeks to return results. […]
sources.summary_zh: 乳癌是美國女性中最常被診斷出的癌症，然而醫療照護的落差卻相當巨大。過半數 40 歲以上的女性並未按照建議進行年度篩檢。放射科醫師在同事人數減少的情況下，卻要解讀更多的乳房攝影檢查。而當確診結果出爐時，決定治療方針的檢測往往需要數週才能返回結果。 […]
